transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess what brings me in is... at night, I’ll start picking at leftovers, and once I start, I have a hard time stopping. Part of me is saying, “That’s enough, Alejandro,” but my hand just keeps going back for more anyway.
Do you usually feel stressed or upset before you start picking at leftovers at night?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern like that. Sometimes I’m just sitting there at night and I start eating, but I can’t say it’s always because I’m stressed or upset.
Do you feel better or more relieved after you've finished eating the leftovers at night?

I’m not sure I’d say I feel better. Sometimes there’s a little bit of relief just because I’m done, but mostly I don’t really notice a good feeling afterward. It’s more like... I just stop and move on, I guess.
Are you usually hungry when you start picking at leftovers at night?

Not usually, no. A lot of times I’ve already had a decent dinner with everybody, so I’m not really hungry. But later on I’ll still go to the fridge, open containers, and start tasting one thing, then another.
Has this nighttime eating behavior been causing problems for you in your daily life?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting my errands done and making my appointments, and I help around the house. But the mornings after it happens, I feel kind of sluggish, and I don’t feel too good about how I’m handling myself.
Do you feel guilty after eating the leftovers at night?

I’m not really sure I’d call it guilt. I don’t feel good about it afterward, but it’s more like disappointment in myself, I guess. I kind of think, “Why did I do that again?” and then I try not to dwell on it.
Do you feel like you have control over whether or not you start eating the leftovers at night?

Not really, no. I mean, I can tell myself, that’s enough, Alejandro, just close the fridge and go to bed. But once I’ve started picking at things, my hand just keeps going back for more anyway. It feels like I’m not fully in control of stopping it.
Has your nighttime eating behavior caused any problems in your relationships with family or friends?
Not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, nobody’s said anything to me about it, and I don’t think it’s caused arguments or anything like that. It feels more like something I’m dealing with myself.
Have you experienced any problems with sexual performance or interest?
I haven’t really noticed any problems there. My interest is maybe not something I think about a lot, but I wouldn’t say it’s been a concern for me.
Do you think your nighttime eating is ever triggered by feelings such as anxiety, boredom, or sadness?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear connection like that. Sometimes I’m just up and the food is there, and I start picking at it. I haven’t really thought of it as being because I’m sad or anxious.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest in activities you used to enjoy?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still do the things I usually like when I feel up to it. I haven’t noticed a big drop in interest or anything like that.
Has your nighttime eating behavior ever seemed to be related to or affected by your sexual activity or desires?
No, I can’t say I’ve noticed any connection like that. My nighttime eating doesn’t really seem tied to sexual activity or desire, at least not that I’m aware of.
Do you think your nighttime eating has anything to do with not feeling like having sex?
I don’t really think so. I haven’t noticed my eating at night being tied to whether I feel like having sex or not. It just doesn’t seem connected to me.
Do you think you eat at night because you are not interested in sex at that time?
No, I don’t think that’s why. I haven’t noticed any connection between eating at night and not being interested in sex then.
Do you ever use eating at night as a way to avoid having sex with your partner?
No, I don’t use it that way. I don’t think my eating at night is about avoiding sex with my partner.
Do you think your nighttime eating could be related to difficulties or concerns you have about your sexual life?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t really seen my eating at night as being tied to problems or worries about my sex life. It feels like a separate thing to me.
Do you ever find yourself eating at night when you would normally be intimate with your partner?
I can’t really say that I’ve noticed that happening. If I eat at night, I don’t think of it as being instead of being intimate. It just feels like a separate thing to me.
Do you think you eat at night as a way to fulfill a physical or emotional need that isn't being met through sexual activity?

I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought of it that way. It doesn’t feel to me like I’m trying to replace something sexual with food. I just notice the eating as its own thing, not really connected to that.
Do you think eating at night fills a void or need that you might otherwise fulfill through sexual activity?
I don’t really think so. I haven’t noticed it filling that kind of need. When I eat at night, it just feels more like eating, not like it’s connected to sex or replacing anything that way.
Do you think your eating at night is related to a lack of sexual activity?
No, I don’t really see a connection there. I haven’t noticed my nighttime eating being tied to whether or not I’m sexually active. It feels like a separate thing to me.
